summary: More community.windows deprecations: win_eventlog, win_feature_info, win_file_compression, win_firewall, win_hosts, win_hotfix and win_http_proxy redirect to ansible.windows, and win_iis_virtualdirectory, win_iis_webapplication and win_iis_webapppool are replaced by microsoft.iis virtual_directory, web_application and web_app_pool.

answer_card.title: IIS modules moved to microsoft.iis
answer_card.answer_md:
| Deprecated (community.windows) | Use |
|---|---|
| `win_iis_virtualdirectory` | `microsoft.iis.virtual_directory` |
| `win_iis_webapplication` | `microsoft.iis.web_application` |
| `win_iis_webapppool` | `microsoft.iis.web_app_pool` |
| `win_iis_webbinding`, `win_iis_website` | `microsoft.iis.website` |

They are removed in community.windows 4.0.0.
